title: RepoPilot fixture configuration
description: Committed at the root of every repository fixture as repopilot.fixture.json. Defines the fixture's identity, its sandbox image, and the exhaustive allow-list of test commands the system may execute. A command absent from this file cannot be run (FR-022, Principle II).

slug.description: Stable identifier; must also appear in the deployment's allowed set.

image.description: Pre-baked container image with all dependencies already restored. The sandbox runs with no network, so nothing may be fetched at test time.

workdir.description: Mount point of the run's disposable working copy inside the container.

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard limit; on expiry the container is killed and the run reports a timeout (FR-023, SC-009).

commands.description: Exhaustive allow-list. run_tests selects by name only; there is no parameter that accepts a command string.

name.description: Referenced by run_tests.command_name and by evaluation task definitions.

argv.description: Argument vector, executed directly. Never a shell string — no shell is invoked, so operators such as && or | have no special meaning and are rejected.

indexing.description: Optional per-fixture overrides layered on top of the global exclusion set. Overrides may narrow what is indexed; they may not widen it to include an excluded category.

documentationGlobs.description: Paths treated as documentation for search_docs. Defaults to README*, docs/**, and **/*.md.

examples.description: Small ASP.NET Core service used as an evaluation fixture.
